newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan should see sustainable recovery in 97/98-EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan should see sustainable recovery in 97/98-EPA.

text.p: Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Taro Aso said on Monday that Japan is likely to achieve a self-sustainable economic recovery led by domestic demand in the fiscal year starting on April 1.
He told the opening session of parliament's Lower House that Japan will manage monetary policy appropriately, while ensuring that improving private demand leads an autonomous recovery.
"The economic recovery may slow down in the first half of 1997/98 due to some negative effects from tax reforms, but we expect to achieve sustainable economic growth gradually," he said.
The government on Monday formally approved forecasts of major economic indicators for 1997/98, including 1.9 pecent growth in gross domestic product.
